helpful: The provisioned petition text with the Eighth Circuit and district court opinions in its appendix: the panel's actual primary ground could be read directly rather than inferred from the QP.
The sal-v4 band table with bracketed reached rates per Term, which made the pooled anchor a one-line computation.
gaps: fedcourts query has no subject or keyword filter for SCOTUS rows (--topic is circuit-only), so it cannot surface substantively similar cert petitions such as prior Erie/state-insurance-law petitions and their fates; --disposition plus --era returns the most recent rows regardless of subject.
No statpack cut for the call-for-response rate or for relist hazard conditional on a waived response, which is the state most single-distribution paid petitions are in.
No committed baseline for the conditional summary-disposition share of grants; the per-Term granted/gvr split is flagged as not comparable across Terms.
notes: Respondent waived, so no BIO existed to provision; the absence was correct rather than a gap. Total retrieval: 2 corpus queries, 2 MCP searches.
